sources_read: .qc-cache/coldwater-strict-2026-10-02-r11/rules/WebDev Rubrics QC.xlsx (Quality Checks row 5 = check 4; Internal Quality Checks row 5; Deterministic Checks row 31 check-runtime-contract-strings.py)
evidence:
RUNTIME CONTRACT HALF: stated and consistent. Entry path and start command: integration.md:3 'Put the finished app in /app. We start it with node /app/server.js from a working directory that may be outside /app' (test.sh:68, 97-111 launches node /app/server.js or the /tmp/submission copy). Port: integration.md:3 'Listen on 0.0.0.0:3000' (test.sh:108 PORT="3000", probes 127.0.0.1:3000). Health: integration.md:3 'answer GET /api/health promptly' (test.sh:48). Storage: integration.md:9 'Use SQLite ... The default database path is /app/app.db. If DB_PATH is set, open that absolute path instead, including when the app runs from a writable copy outside /app' (test.sh:98-109). Runtime packages: integration.md:5 'Node 22, Express and better-sqlite3 through NODE_PATH' and 'must not require an install or build step'. Seed: instruction.md:3 and integration.md:7 '/assets/seed_data.json ... contains no user snippets'. Accounts: instruction.md:5 'without signing in', overview.md:3 'without accounts', matching app_context.md:10 'None'. Symlink rule: integration.md:11 matches test.sh:72-83. Fixed clock: none stated and none needed; no criterion grades a date or time-of-day figure and the seed has no dated records (N-A component). Minor note: test.sh also injects PORT and HOME, which the notes do not name as variables; the port value is stated literally and the frozen template integration note does the same, so this is not a defect.

GRADED-BUT-NOT-ASKED HALF: I mapped every gate, functional, polish and visual criterion to the notes. All map to a stated requirement except one navigation dependency. tests/scored/functional/judge.toml, cw_caret_kept_in_view: 'Put the caret at the very start, then move it to the end of the document with the keyboard and type a marker ... Move the caret back to the document start with the keyboard: the first line must be visible again', on 'a draft with more lines than fit in the visible editor (for example sixty short numbered lines)'. The public key contract in ui.md:5 is only 'Support normal typing, paste, new lines, Backspace, Delete, arrows, Home and End'; nothing in the notes asks for a document-start or document-end key (Ctrl/Cmd+Home, Ctrl/Cmd+End, PageUp/PageDown). The golden implements exactly that unrequested shortcut (solution/app/src/custom-editor.js:279-285 'if (key === 'home' || key === 'end') { ... moveCaret(event.key, event.shiftKey, true)' under ctrlKey/metaKey, and :788-792 documentEdge), so the golden cannot expose the gap. The criterion neither names the keys to use nor says that repeated arrow presses are the expected route, and the functional prompt adds 'Fail fast: after two failed attempts at the same control or step, stop and fail that criterion'. The same unstated jump is implied, less sharply, in cw_undo_restores_caret ('Move the caret to the end of the last line with the keyboard', four lines).

MEASUREMENT: qc/runs/coldwater-strict-2026-10-02-r11/raw-evidence-index.json does not exist, so there is no judge-run evidence showing which keys the configured judge actually presses for this step. This finding is from source reading only; no judge, Oracle, model or portal result is claimed.
counterexample: Conforming alternative that can fail: an app implementing every key ui.md lists (arrows, Home and End acting on the current line, with correct scroll-follow) but no Ctrl/Cmd+End or Ctrl/Cmd+Home. The judge, told to 'move it to the end of the document with the keyboard' in a sixty-line draft, presses Control+End; the caret goes only to the end of line 1 (or nowhere), a retry gives the same result, and the fail-fast rule fails cw_caret_kept_in_view although the app scrolls the caret into view correctly for every publicly required key. Plausible broken app for the runtime half: none found; an app ignoring DB_PATH, the port or the entry path is caught by test.sh and the restart criterion as the notes describe.
suggested_fix: Either state the keys in the criterion (for example: 'press ArrowDown until the caret is on the last line, then End; do not rely on Ctrl+End or Ctrl+Home, which the app need not support', and the reverse with ArrowUp and Home), or add document-start/document-end shortcuts to the key list in ui.md so the graded route is publicly required. Apply the same wording to cw_undo_restores_caret.
